deliberately_unsupported_actions.ACTOR_RECIPIENT_RELATION: Recognition participants describe state subjects, not event actor and recipient roles.
deliberately_unsupported_actions.BALL_RECEIPT: Recognition has no authenticated receipt or possession-transition assertion.
deliberately_unsupported_actions.CARRY: Recognition has movement states but no authenticated ball ownership or carry interval.
deliberately_unsupported_actions.CAUSAL_RELATION: Recognition contains no normative causal evidence.
deliberately_unsupported_actions.PASS: Recognition has no authenticated event type or passer-recipient action assertion.
deliberately_unsupported_actions.SAME_PLAYER_FOOTBALL_CONTINUATION: Adjacent state recurrence does not prove continuation of a football action.
deliberately_unsupported_actions.SHOT: Recognition has no authenticated event type or shot assertion.
deliberately_unsupported_actions.TACTICAL_PATTERN: Pattern Recognition is outside this slice and atomic states do not prove a pattern.
